svg.title: From a film negative to playable content: asset reuse and generation
svg.desc: The player finds a negative. AI plans a photo based on the investigation. Existing tables, shelves and folders are reused. Supported new clue photos are generated, validated and added to gameplay. The diagram shows original transparent assets and an illustrative room assembled from those same assets.

g.text: Prepare a photo tied to the story
① Table ② Shelf ③ Folder ④ Photo
Real assets, assembled as an illustration
Individual assets become an explorable scene
Generated when the story needs it; a wait is required
